_comment: OWNERSHIP: These shared test vectors are owned by the CONTRACTS TEAM (contracts/token-factory maintainers). They are the single source of truth for percent and fee computations and MUST be updated in lockstep with BOTH the contract implementation (contracts/token-factory) and the backend implementation (backend fee/percent math). Any change to rounding, basis points, or fee formulas requires updating this file and re-running the differential tests on both sides. Do not edit these vectors without coordinating with the contracts team.
_description: Differential test vectors for percent and fee computations. Each vector specifies inputs and the expected result. Both the contract math and the backend math must produce exactly the expected result; any mismatch fails the differential test.

percentVectors.description: Percent of zero amount is zero
1 bps of a large amount truncates toward zero
Sub-unit result truncates to zero (floor division)
Result with remainder truncates toward zero
5000 bps (50%) of an odd amount truncates
Percent of a large amount near u64 range
Percent of a large amount with truncation
Typical 30 bps (0.3%) of a common amount

feeVectors.description: Fee on zero amount is zero
Zero fee bps yields zero fee and full net
10000 bps fee takes the entire amount
Fee truncates to zero for sub-unit results
Fee with remainder truncates toward zero; net is amount minus fee
Fee on odd amount with truncation
Full fee on max u64 amount
Partial fee on max u64 amount with truncation
Fee on a single unit truncates to zero
